implementation.name: Pre-packaging outreach workflow
implementation.changes: Historical drafting, coordination and preparation included manual steps. The published skill was packaged after these outcomes.

cohort.target_context: Single target campaign; organization and sender profile withheld
cohort.inclusion_rule: All 53 fully tracked people in the frozen campaign cohort, including nonresponders. A person contacted on several channels counts once.
cohort.exclusions: Four additional known approaches had incomplete logs or a different target scope. They are outside the 53-person cohort.

observation.notes: Exact dates and timezone omitted from this public aggregate. Ages are approximate, based on recorded first-contact dates that can differ from live renderings. They do not describe time since the latest outgoing message. Some follow-ups were very recent. This frozen snapshot is not a new live check.

policy.notes: This describes the intended policy. Known premature follow-ups violated it; configuration is not evidence of compliance.

known_incidents.notes: Three known premature follow-ups repeated the initial pitch. These are the same three incidents, not two sets of three. Total automation error rates cannot be reconstructed.

evidence.notes: Aggregate counts were checked against a frozen private retrospective. The underlying contact history is intentionally not public and cannot be independently reproduced here.

limitations: Small nonrandom cohort with uneven observation periods.
Recipient, channel and relationship mix can affect outcomes.
No causal claim about wording, automation or the newly packaged skill.
Formal hiring interviews, job offers and complete action totals are unknown.
Broader known history gives 5 of 57 completed chats (8.8%), but has incomplete logs and different scope; it is not a competing standardized cohort.
